report_modes.source_behavior: InventoryStatusGetDefaultSearchOptionResolver resolves aggregate_key.key for template group; aggregate_key.type defaults fixed. Source comment explicitly fixed=현황/free=집계. It selects current model from menu.definition.model_info_list and current template from dynamic attributes.
report_modes.line_classification: checkAggregate returns false for fixed with details_target.value=line; also false for free when the set of prop_id values in aggregate entries has only grid summary_line prop. Missing aggregate =>true; other cases=>true. This is an aggregate-mode boolean, not a quantity/amount aggregation formula.
report_modes.summary_models: Free conditions produce summary1..N model ids/subtotal1..N reference types; fixed details_target.props similarly creates summary models. Definitions resolved by current template/group and possibly extra targets.
report_modes.unknown: Exact current grouping menu option list, selected values and backend group-by/total formulas remain external.

search.entry: Fresh actions SelectInventoryStatusUserAction delegates SearchDataModelGenerateProgram with InventoryStatusSearchBuildProcessFeature, uses payload search_type/options/file_type and graph flag; missing allowed template list alerts and returns. Retained V56 action follows same general feature pipeline with explicit dynamic template resource loading.
search.header: HEADER and SIMPLE map to header resolver; resets quick_search/condition_quick, page.current_index=1, limit from menu page_size, default sort from template or grid attr, virtual-scroll runtime reset.
search.quick: QUICK maps own resolver; page/limit reset, quick text from payload or route.keyword, configures quick-search common program and default sorting when instant_dmc exists.
search.F3: Current F3 is parent UI observation. Retained module contains comment mentioning Search(F3); actual shortcut registration/control binding is not captured, so no keyboard equivalence claim.

server_query_boundary.request: DataModelModifierForSearchConditionProgram builds conditions/sorts/groups/flow_condition from search DMC and option_sort; query sends menu_type,bizz_sid,page,limit,quick condition, additional/template context. Definition/condition builder and server enforcement are separate dependencies.
server_query_boundary.response: Returns result.data,total_number,date as data_model,total_count,date. SearchDataModelResolver can retry page1 when total_count>0 but page data empty; body_use_tf=false skips body query.
server_query_boundary.unknown: No query was executed. Server sums, order, null/duplicate handling, permissions, quantities/prices/tax arithmetic and comparison period calculations are unobserved.

comparison.source_behavior: Literal aggregate?.comparison_period !== string0 plus two-array response triggers normalization: first array rows __period_index=1, second=2, concatenate. setPageData stores server-returned date in ICompareDateOptionRuntime.
comparison.drilldown: Fresh actions StandardUserAction uses comparison column suffix and runtime date.compare.from/to for secondary-period drilldown, and resets comparison_period0/detail line in target search; exact date generation is not in these bodies.
comparison.unknown: 전년/전월/전주/전일 code mapping, leap-day handling, week start, inclusive end date, matching aggregation buckets and ratio/difference arithmetic remain unknown.

sorting.source_behavior: SORT resolver rebuilds search_options.sort from payload; preserves form page-separate sort prefix, disables its subtotal flags, adds clicked-column sorts after max prefix priority, stores ISortInfoRuntime and previous content scroll. Header search separately reapplies template default sort.
sorting.unknown: Actual comparator/locale/numeric/null order on server and current column-click cycle not established by syntax.

excel.source_behavior: EXCEL search_type maps InventoryExcelSearchResolver; EXCEL post-process selects InventoryStatusDownloadExcelResolver instead of normal UI update. Download resolver delegates excel$DownloadExcelProgram using fetched models/definitions/current template, default file_type xlsx, download_mode, is_check_file_security=true and title/date context.
excel.limits: Search resolver alerts when EXCEL total_count>100000; actual truncation behavior is not established by this alert.
excel.unknown: Actual export framework/permission policy/file contents and current footer binding are external; V3 ecount.document.exportExcel is a separate path.
